observations: Two large automotive transfer cases lying on a concrete floor.
The cases are marked with 'F15' in white paint on the top surface.
The cases show significant surface rust and dirt, indicating they have been stored for some time.
A clutch assembly is visible to the left in photo 0.
The cases are positioned next to a transmission housing, suggesting they are part of a complete transmission rebuild kit.
Watermarks for 'CHIDEX INVESTMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all images.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show the 'F15' marking on the cases.

claims.claim: all BMW Engine and Gearbox part
claims.evidence: The seller cannot be seen to confirm the presence of all parts; the photos only show the housing.

risks.risk: The case may be a used or refurbished unit rather than a new original equipment unit (OE).
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the side or back of the case).

risks.risk: The case may be missing essential internal components like the input shaft or the clutch assembly.
risks.proof: A photo showing the interior of the case with the clutch assembly and input shaft visible.

risks.risk: The case may have internal leaks or mechanical damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the case being filled with water to check for leaks.

risks.risk: The seller may be selling a different model or a non-BMW part.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the specific model and serial number.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the model and serial number.
Photo of the interior of the case showing the clutch assembly and input shaft.
Video of the case being filled with water to check for leaks.
Confirmation of the condition of the clutch assembly.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used transmission housing for a BMW X5 F15 from the markings in the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as used.
